title: [ISS DSB]Distant Shock Barrier
description: 👓When spell power goes out of control, let distance become the price of destruction.
body:
⚔️ Distant Shock Barrier ⚔️

When spell power goes out of control, let distance become the price of destruction

--- ## 🌩️ Overview - **Distant Shock Barrier** is an addon for **[Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/irons-spells-n-spellbooks)** that solves performance issues caused by excessively large spell ranges. > When spell power becomes too high, spell ranges can expand to **100-200 blocks**, causing massive computational overhead. This mod caps the maximum spell range and converts exceeded range into bonus damage. ```diff + Fixes TPS drops from oversized spells + Maintains high-level spell threat + Fully configurable damage conversion ``` --- ## ⚔️ Features | Feature | Description | Benefit | |:---:|:---|:---| | 🛡️ **Range Limiting** | Configurable max spell radius cap | Prevents client/server lag | | ⚔️ **Damage Conversion** | Excess range → damage bonus | Balanced risk/reward | | 👁️ **Visual Feedback** | Tooltips & spell wheel display | Real-time stat visibility | | ⚙️ **Configurable** | In-game menu + config file | Pack-friendly customization | --- ## 🎮 Configuration | Option | Default | Description | |:---|:---:|:---| | `maxSpellRange` | `50.0` | Maximum spell range (blocks) | | `rangeToDamageRatio` | `0.5` | Damage bonus per exceeded block | | `enableRangeLimit` | `true` | Master toggle for range limiting | | `spellWheelOffsetX` | `150` | Spell wheel tooltip X offset | | `spellWheelOffsetY` | `0` | Spell wheel tooltip Y offset | | `debugMode` | `false` | Enable debug logging | ---
**⚡ Every block of distance becomes destruction**
